name: excalidraw-manager
description: Cross-platform desktop manager for local Excalidraw boards.

scripts.build: npm run prepare:runtime && tsc && vite build
scripts.test:runtime: node tests/formula-completion-trigger.mjs && node tests/formula-template-insertion.mjs && node tests/provider-registry.mjs && node tests/formula-ocr-provider.mjs && node tests/formula-capture-helper.mjs && node tests/runtime-services.mjs
scripts.check:runtime: node --check runtime/server.mjs && node --check runtime/formula-server.mjs && node --check runtime/formula-overlay.mjs && node --check runtime/formula-provider-registry.mjs
